_notes: E8 - Finalize gross pay. E2's crew, picker and job on day -18: 06:00-19:00, no meal, 8 regular / 4 overtime / 1 double, 320.00.
Reusing E2's measured day keeps all three buckets non-zero, so Regular + Overtime + Double = Net is not vacuous.
Net = Gross - Meals is trivially true at Meals 0; the schema says so rather than pretending otherwise.
Report contents are never parsed (no PDF/xlsx parser); the Totals bar and the crew row carry the numeric proof.
Test File is read-only here. The ready/cannot-export split belongs to E9 (export file) and A4 (earning codes).
